themes: Indonesia's coal export demand remains structurally supported by Asian power generation needs, with domestic players like BAJA and INDY benefiting from stable pricing and local offtake agreements.

US interest rate sensitivity creates divergence: ID-listed miners outperform as rupiah stability aids margins, while US-exposed names like BHP face cost pressure from stronger dollar.
sectors.ai: Indonesia's mining & energy sector shows resilience with domestic names like BAJA (+34.55%) and ALKA (+25.00%) surging, while US-listed peers lag. Focus on coal and nickel plays as global demand shifts; INDY and BKR gains signal local strength. Maintain overweight on ID-listed miners, but watch for US macro headwinds that could pressure BHP and SHW.

US solar inverter and tracker stocks (ENPH, ARRY, SEDG) face structural margin compression from Chinese overcapacity and tariff uncertainty, making them high-risk holds for Indonesia-focused portfolio
sectors.ai: Indonesia's renewables sector shows selective strength in EV components (VKTR) and geothermal (PGEO) despite aggregate weakness. Capitalize on VKTR's momentum as Indonesia's nickel downstreaming and EV ecosystem buildout accelerates, while monitoring US solar names (ENPH, ARRY) for tariff-driven volatility. Avoid broad exposure; focus on domestic plays tied to the national energy transition mandate.

Regulatory push for domestic pharmaceutical self-sufficiency (JECX) and chronic disease management (RLCO) underpins long-term growth, independent of global rate cycles.

Focus on JECX and RSCH as domestic proxies for structural demand, but maintain caution on lagging ID performance.
